proof_body:
by
  intro p hp
  have h : -1 < -p := by linarith
  refine ⟨intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_rpow' h, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_rpow (Or.inl h), Real.one_rpow, Real.zero_rpow (by linarith)]
  have h1 : 1 - p ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have h2 : -p + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  field_simp
  ring
target_source: ∀ p : ℝ, p < 1 → IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-p)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 ∧ (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x ^ (-p)) = 1 / (1 - p)
